pr_title: Fix low-level and legacy HTTP API
pr_body:
* OCSP HTTP: Restore API of undocumented and recently deprecated functions:
  ```  
    Restore parameters of OCSP_REQ_CTX_new(), OCSP_REQ_CTX_http(), OCSP_REQ_CTX_i2d().
    Fix a bug (wrong HTTP method selected on req == NULL in OCSP_sendreq_new().
    Minor further fixes in OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX.pod
 Fixes #13873.
 
* `OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX.pod`: minor addition and remove redundant paragraph
* ` OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_new()`: replace` method_GET` parameter by `method_POST`
* rename `OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_header` to `OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_set_request_line`
* Add check of HTTP method to `OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_content()`
* `Util/Pod.pm`: Fix uninitialized `$podinfo{lastsecttext}` on empty input

##### Checklist
<!-- Remove items that do not apply. For completed items, change [ ] to [x]. -->
- [x] documentation is added or updated
pr_comments:
> Un-deprecate OCSP_REQ_CTX_set1_req() because it is helpful also for internal use.

Er, internal use isn't a reason to undeprecate it...
This pull request is ready to merge

I just so happened to have a look at 1.1.1 vs master for these things, and well, it seems you missed a spot:

1.1.1:
``` C
int OCSP_REQ_CTX_nbio_d2i(OCSP_REQ_CTX *rctx, ASN1_VALUE **pval,
                          const ASN1_ITEM *it);
```

master:
``` C
#   define OCSP_REQ_CTX_nbio_d2i(r, i) \
        OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_sendreq_d2i(r, i)
```

The number of arguments differ...
The fix turned out to be very simple.  #14196

issue_context.title: OCSP_REQ_CTX API is quite broken going from 1.0.2 to 3.0.0
comments: So as not to create another mess, I'd suggest that we allow #13742 to be merged first, and fix back the API after.  There's a risk that #13742 becomes overly entangled otherwise.

> So as not to create another mess, I'd suggest that we allow #13742 to be merged first, and fix back the API after. There's a risk that #13742 becomes overly entangled otherwise.

Agreed

Thanks @jwalch for your detailed error report.
I was already about to write that this issue is related also to #13742, 
which properly deprecates and documents also the formerly undocumented legacy OCSP HTTP functions.

Yes, although undocumented, the number of parameters of  `OCSP_REQ_CTX_i2d()` should not have changed.
This is an oversight for which I apologize. 
I'll fix this as soon as #13742 is finished and merged, which should happen within the next couple of days.

For `OCSP_sendreq_new()` I changed the implementation in order to take advantage of the meanwhile strengthened implementation while of course aiming at semantic compatibility. Sorry to hear that this did not work out fully.
I'm going to fix this as well when #13742 is merged.

While fixing, would you mind renaming `OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_header` -> `OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_http`, seeing that this function sets the *HTTP command*, which isn't a header?
(the old name was `OCSP_REQ_CTX_http`, btw...).
As currently named, I find this function much to easy to confuse with `OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_add1_header`...

I found the old name `OCSP_REQ_CTX_http` pretty unclear if not confusing (for instance, it could have been misunderstood as if it was doing an HTTP transfer) and therefore renamed it to `OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_header` when updating the name prefix.
Therefore I would not like to rename it (essentially) back to `OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_http`.

The new documentation added by #13742 nicely says:
```
OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_header() adds an HTTP request line to the request context.
```

> seeing that this function sets the HTTP command, which isn't a header?

I meanwhile understand that the HTTP request line (which includes the method) is not considered part of the header.
So I suggest renaming it to `OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_set_request_line`, which is much more to the point.

I will also correct the brief internal documentation of the function in `http_client.c` which currently says:
```
 * Create HTTP header using given op and path (or "/" in case path is NULL).
```
to
```
 * Create HTTP request line using the given |ctx| and |path| (or "/" in case |path| is NULL).
```

> So I suggest renaming it to `OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_set_request_line`, which is much more to the point.

Yes, even better!

@jwalch, in anticipation of #13742 being merged soon,
I've already tentatively fixed all the issues you reported here 
in https://github.com/siemens/openssl/tree/fix_13873_HTTP_method_API:
```
    OCSP HTTP: Restore API of undocumented and recently deprecated functions
    
    Restore parameters of OCSP_REQ_CTX_new(), OCSP_REQ_CTX_http(), OCSP_REQ_CTX_i2d().
    Un-deprecate OCSP_REQ_CTX_set1_req() because it is helpful also for internal use.
    Fix a bug (wrong HTTP method selected on req == NULL in OCSP_sendreq_new().
```
I'll submit this as a PR as soon as possible (likely tomorrow) but you might already have a look at it.
